title: hedyotis dichotoma
intro: Hedyotis dichotoma, commonly known as Bu Gu Zhi, is a traditional Chinese medicine plant that belongs to the family Rubiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, reducing blood pressure, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis dichotoma are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and anti-hyperlipidemic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions such as atherosclerosis and hypertension. The bioactive constituents of Hedyotis dichotoma include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
